_note: Two shapes on purpose. Shape 1 (oslo:Besluit) is the original input, read by the translation step. Shape 2 (eli:Expression) is the artifact the service's own translation emits, read by downstream segmentation/NER. The reader matches whichever shape is in a task's input container, so this one spec serves both the with- and without-translation pipelines (without translation, downstream reads the original besluiten and shape 2 matches nothing).
